Cefrey is one of the bandits raiding the Overgrown Ruins in Act One.

Involvement

Act One

Cefrey is in the Refectory inspecting the library for loot together with  Barton,  Haseid, and  Torgga, wWhile  Mari patrols the antechamber and  Andorn guards the Chapel Entrance. Cefrey and the others are instantly hostile to the party.
